system.notes: A flywheel presses against a polyceramic block, throwing 2cm x 2cm fragments; as effective as a shotgun but no louder than an electric toothbrush. Game notes: 2D6 fragments per hit, each 1D6/2 damage; treat as knife for armor penetration. The damage roll here is all fragments together; by the book armor is taken off each fragment separately. The internal power cell spins the flywheel for up to eighteen minutes (7eb per cell). A cyberarm version retails at 550eb (HC 1D6+2). The book's stat row prints no range; 40m is the Reference Book's figure. (Chromebook 1 p.42)
